nodes.label: Early Length Check for Array Comparisons
nodes.rationale: Arrays of different length cannot be equal, so an O(1) length guard precedes any expensive sort/join/deep-equality comparison. The rewritten hasChanges() also avoids allocating joined strings, avoids mutating the inputs by using toSorted(), and breaks on the first differing element. Impact MEDIUM-HIGH, greatest in hot paths such as event handlers and render loops.
